clarifications.force_increment_rationale: This removes a grammatical ambiguity in the parent protocol's prose and matches a nonnegative change from the trajectory-local shallowest-frame baseline.
clarifications.false_safe_rate: number of certified selected nonzero actions whose realized force exceeds the limit divided by all material-budget decisions for that policy
clarifications.selected_probe_count: number of distinct first optional probes selected by the decision-directed policy across the 20 source-test materials
clarifications.simultaneous_force_coverage: fraction of materials for which every registered nonzero held action is upper-covered at all four probe budgets of the evaluated policy
clarifications.trajectory_tie_break: if maximum z_frame occurs more than once, use the first CSV row at that maximum
